name: What permits are needed for foreclosed property renovations in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: What permits are needed for foreclosed property renovations in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Renovating a foreclosed property in Daly City typically requires various permits depending on the scope of work. Structural changes, additions, major electrical or plumbing upgrades, and significant alterations to the building's exterior will generally require permits from the City of Daly City Planning and Building Department. Minor cosmetic work, like painting or flooring, often does not. Your general contractor can help identify and secure all necessary permits, ensuring compliance with local building codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are often needed for structural, electrical, plumbing, or major exterior changes in Daly City. A contractor can help navigate the permitting process.
